headline: Publishes the container image for the v0.10.6 fixes
summary: A maintenance release. The v0.10.6 platform binaries carried a large batch of sync-correctness and hardening fixes but its container image did not publish; v0.10.7 carries the identical fixes and provides the multi-architecture container image. The only source change from v0.10.6 is a development-time lint adjustment that is not part of the shipped binary, so the v0.10.6 and v0.10.7 binaries are functionally equivalent. No configuration changes are required. See the v0.10.6 notes for the full list of fixes.

items.title: Container image available for the v0.10.6 fix set
items.body: The container image at ghcr.io/dotcoocoo/hermitstash-sync is published for this release, carrying the same sync-correctness, data-loss, and security fixes shipped in the v0.10.6 platform binaries. Operators on the pre-built binaries are already covered by v0.10.6; container users should pull this release.
